channel.title: Microsoft Corporation — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Microsoft Corporation (microsoft).

item.title: CVE-2026-112732 · 9.8 CRITICAL — Microsoft Office Visio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: Double free in Microsoft Office Visio allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-109484 · 10 CRITICAL ☁️ — Azure App Service for Linux Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
item.description: Failure to sanitize special elements into a different plane (special element injection) in Azure App Service allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-81962 · 8.6 HIGH ☁️ — Azure Machine Learning Information Disclosure Vulnerability
item.description: Incorrect authorization in Azure Machine Learning allows an unauthorized attacker to disclose information over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-70305 · 9.6 CRITICAL ☁️ — Azure Portal Spoofing Vulnerability
item.description: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') in Azure Portal allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-70193 · 9.9 CRITICAL ☁️ — Microsoft Office SharePoint Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-69899 · 9.1 CRITICAL ☁️ — Azure DevTest Labs Spoofing Vulnerability
